description: This file defines the ViewLanguages class for handling the languages management interface in the SuiteCRM administration module. It includes methods for access control, module title parameters, and rendering language enabling/disabling UI elements based on configuration.

classes.name: ViewLanguages
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, providing functionalities to manage and display language options within the SuiteCRM admin panel.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns array of HTML links used for the module title display, indicating the current module and action.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges before allowing access to the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares language configuration data and renders the Languages.tpl template for the language management interface.
